summary: Stop Jarvis from speaking one turn late: give Live speech a real local completion signal instead of the 30 s OUTPUT_TIMEOUT_S fallback, and separate durable truth (Core/brain) from the presentation attempt (SpeechRequest) so stale formulations stop being spoken after the user takes the floor, while the brain still decides what to re-say.
locked_constraints: A result stays true in Core; only the unstarted formulation loses its right to be spoken on its own.
The brain, never an age rule in the scheduler, decides whether an older reply is still worth saying; it receives it as pending_replies.
No job or sub-agent is cancelled by any interruption (Decisions 15 and 35).
supersede_stale_replies=True (bulk dependency invalidation) is not re-enabled.
On Live, anything already appended to the provider cannot be recalled (invalidate_unstarted_output is a no-op): every hold happens before speak_reserved.
A speech of the current intent is always served before any speech of an older intent.
The classic (non-Live) pipeline keeps its response_done-based completion; parity tests prove it.
Every new state/reason is traced and visible in the conversation timeline; nothing is dropped silently.
planning_blockers: The session behind the user's 2026-09-28 transcript (12:54–12:59) is not in any local journal (local Core DBs stop on 2026-09-21). Slice 00 asks the Human for that session's DB/trace or accepts the 18–21/09 evidence as baseline.
